title: Executive at Technology Firm Sees Samsara Gaining Share Amid Demand for a Unified Operations Platform
expert: Technology sales leader at a large North American systems integrator and reseller (enterprise and mid-market)
verdict: The expert's Samsara channel business grew 35% y/y in Aug–Oct 2026, led by expansion, with retention over 100%.

Enterprise expansion ($100K+ cohort): 🟢 Retention over 100%; 60% of selling time on expansion, vs 2026-11-05 call (96% renewals): higher; vs Jefferies license-cost scrutiny (SB #62601): conflicting. → Tenet 1 (enterprise expansion) ↑
🟢 CY26 channel revenue at least +25% (estimate), vs 2026-11-06 VP +8%–11%: well above.
GM/FCF through component cycle: 🟢 Pricing about +9% y/y (estimate), on new designs not supply, vs 2026-11-06 VP +3%–5% and MSP director +15%–20%: mid-range. → Tenet 3 (op leverage vs hardware cost) ↑
🔴 Premium price is the most common reason for lost deals, especially small fleets.
Competition & share: 🟢 Lytx, Verizon Connect, Trimble, Omnitracs losing share, Samsara and Motive winning, Geotab flat; vs 2026-11-05 call (#1/#2 in RFPs): confirming. → Tenet 4 (platform moat) ↑

changes: Retention: over 100% vs 2026-11-05 call's 96% renewal rate: higher; vs Jefferies license-cost scrutiny (SB #62601): conflicting.
Growth outlook: CY26 at least +25% vs 2026-11-06 VP +8%–11%: higher.
Pricing: about +9% y/y vs 2026-11-06 VP +3%–5% and MSP director +15%–20%: mid-range.
Competition: legacy vendors losing share vs 2026-11-05 call's Samsara #1/#2 in RFPs: confirming.
thesis_impact: Tenet 1 (enterprise expansion): ↑ — +35% practice growth, retention over 100%, expansion-led.
Tenet 3 (op leverage vs hardware cost): ↑ — about +9% price; caveat: premium price loses small-fleet deals.
Tenet 4 (platform moat): ↑ — share moving from Lytx, Verizon Connect, Trimble, Omnitracs.
